name_zh: 老挝·法昂：澜沧王国与万象佛教统一
name_en: Laos Fa Ngum: Lan Xang Kingdom & Vientiane Buddhist Unity
description_zh: 法昂 (1316-1393) 澜沧万象王国建立者，娶高棉公主请佛祖舍利入万象，确立上座部佛教国教，整合老挝泰族诸邦，奠定老挝民族疆域与文化认同基础。
description_en: Fa Ngum (1316-1393) Lan Xang Vientiane Kingdom founder, married Khmer princess brought Buddha relics to Vientiane, established Theravada Buddhism state religion, integrated Lao Tai principalities, founded Lao national territory and cultural identity basis.
reason_zh: 法昂代表东南亚佛教王国建构典范，展示了佛教如何作为跨部落文化粘合剂整合分散政体，其澜沧王国疆域大致对应现代老挝版图。
reason_en: Fa Ngum represents Southeast Asian Buddhist kingdom construction paradigm, demonstrating how Buddhism serves as cross-tribal cultural glue integrating fragmented polities, his Lan Xang Kingdom territory roughly corresponds to modern Laos map.
steps_zh: 研究法昂早年高棉宫廷成长与娶公主请舍利
分析1353年万象起兵建立澜沧万象王国
探讨上座部佛教国教确立与僧团制度建设
评估澜沧疆域扩张整合老挝泰族诸邦
总结法昂佛教统一对老挝民族疆域认同的千年奠基
steps_en: Study Fa Ngum early Khmer court upbringing and marrying princess bringing relics
Analyze 1353 Vientiane uprising establishing Lan Xang Vientiane Kingdom
Explore Theravada Buddhism state religion establishment and sangha system construction
Evaluate Lan Xang territory expansion integrating Lao Tai principalities
Summarize Fa Ngum Buddhist unity foundational role for Lao national territory identity millennium
expected_zh: 掌握佛教国教与王国疆域双重建构逻辑，理解宗教如何作为民族认同核心粘合剂，评估澜沧王国对现代老挝版图与文化的决定性遗产。
expected_en: Master Buddhist state religion and kingdom territory dual construction logic, understand religion as national identity core glue, evaluate Lan Xang Kingdom decisive legacy for modern Laos territory and culture.
case_zh: 1316 出生；1353 建国；1373 退位；1393 逝世。澜沧王国佛教统一范式永存。
case_en: 1316 birth; 1353 founded; 1373 abdicated; 1393 death. Lan Xang Kingdom Buddhist unity paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Lan Xang founder; Theravada Buddhism Laos; Vientiane capital; national territory
